messages.content: What is the change in entropy in Joules per Kelvin of a 1kg ice block at 0°C if it is heated to 100°C under 1 atmosphere of pressure?

function.name: entropy_change_calculate
function.description: Calculate the change in entropy for a mass of a specific substance under set initial and final conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

substance.description: The substance for which the change in entropy is calculated.

mass.description: The mass of the substance in kg.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

pressure.description: The pressure the substance is under in atmospheres.

message.content:
**Entropy change for heating a 1 kg ice block from 0 °C to 100 °C (1 atm)**  

The process involves three reversible stages:

| Stage | Process | ΔS (J K⁻¹) |
|-------|---------|------------|
| 1 | Melting of ice at 0 °C (273.15 K) | \( \displaystyle \Delta S_{\text{melt}} = \frac{m\,L_f}{T_{\text{melt}}}\) |
| 2 | Heating liquid water from 0 °C to 100 °C | \( \displaystyle \Delta S_{\text{heat}} = m\,c_{\text{water}}\ln\!\left(\frac{T_{\text{final}}}{T_{\text{initial}}}\right)\) |
| 3 | Vaporising water at 100 °C (373.15 K) | \( \displaystyle \Delta S_{\text{boil}} = \frac{m\,L_v}{T_{\text{boil}}}\) |

---

### Numerical values

| Quantity | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Mass \(m\) | 1 kg |
| Latent heat of fusion \(L_f\) | 334 kJ kg⁻¹ = 334 000 J kg⁻¹ |
| Latent heat of vaporisation \(L_v\) | 2257 kJ kg⁻¹ = 2 257 000 J kg⁻¹ |
| Specific heat of liquid water \(c_{\text{water}}\) | 4.18 kJ kg⁻¹ K⁻¹ = 4180 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹ |
| Initial temperature \(T_i\) | 0 °C = 273.15 K |
| Final temperature \(T_f\) | 100 °C = 373.15 K |

#### 1. Melting

\[
\Delta S_{\text{melt}} = \frac{334\,000}{273.15}
   \approx 1\,222.5\;\text{J K}^{-1}
\]

#### 2. Heating liquid water

\[
\Delta S_{\text{heat}} = 4180 \times \ln\!\left(\frac{373.15}{273.15}\right)
   \approx 4180 \times 0.312
   \approx 1\,305\;\text{J K}^{-1}
\]

#### 3. Boiling

\[
\Delta S_{\text{boil}} = \frac{2\,257\,000}{373.15}
   \approx 6\,050\;\text{J K}^{-1}
\]

---

### Total entropy change

\[
\boxed{\Delta S_{\text{total}}
      = \Delta S_{\text{melt}}
        + \Delta S_{\text{heat}}
        + \Delta S_{\text{boil}}
      \approx 1\,222.5 + 1\,305 + 6\,050
      \approx 8\,577.5\;\text{J K}^{-1}}
\]

Rounded to three significant figures:

\[
\Delta S_{\text{total}} \approx 8.58 \times 10^{3}\;\text{J K}^{-1}
\]

---

**Assumptions & Notes**

* Standard latent heats and specific heat capacities were used (values at 1 atm).
* The process is assumed reversible; thus the integral \( \int dQ_{\text{rev}}/T \) applies directly.
* The calculation neglects any temperature dependence of the specific heat or latent heats beyond the standard values.
